forbidden_signals: Deliberation is activated or made conversation-wide
A checkpoint or approval request is presented
Project files or durable state are created or modified
required_signals: The response separately answers What, Why at all, How, and Why this way for retry backoff with jitter
The response traces a concise request or execution journey from overload through retries to an observable outcome
The response distinguishes the normal protection path from a material failure or limit without becoming a lecture
The response ends as a standalone explanation rather than a decision workflow
